_comment: Per-package gzipped-size budgets in bytes. Measured against dist/index.js (ESM). Numbers are ~25% above the current size — natural growth headroom before CI fails. Tune up explicitly when a primitive batch lands; tune down when a refactor genuinely shrinks output. NOTE on @usemotif/icons: the dist barrel re-exports 1,933 lucide-derived glyphs; the budget reflects the full-barrel size, but real consumers tree-shake to ~100 B gz per imported icon (sideEffects: false guarantees it).
